authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6152 danta explicitly gives Khowar don tooth, plus widespread dand/dā̃t. The generic Khowar donor-category node found by search is not a competing lexical etymon. Non-Khowar dot/dad shapes are compared with the danta family while vowel and nasal-loss details remain qualified. Exact survey form dad is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10648 raśmi gives Punjabi rassī/rassā rope, a family transmitted into several Indo-Aryan languages, and Western Pahari rośśo rope. The survey rasso/rośi shapes match these regional variants; the precise intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing route remains open. Exact survey form rasso is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5155 jala explicitly gives Hindi jal and Gujarati jaḷ water. Mewari jal/jaḷ directly matches; Bagheli jel is compared in the same family with its raised vowel retained as a regional variation. Exact survey form jaḷ is preserved.
